title: Ramadan Bullet Journal 2024 Template
author: stroberihitam
description:
If you are just started using a digital planner, this simple planner template is also perfect for you. It’s simple, you’ll be able to get started easily without spending too much time learning how to use it, and just add pages as you go! No more having tons of blank or unused and unnecessary pages.
HOW TO USE THE PLANNER:
1. FOR DIGITAL PLANNER
– Compatible with PDF editing applications such as GoodNotes, Noteshelf, Notability, Xodo, etc.
– Import PDF file to your tablet or iPad
– This is a digital page template only, there is no hyperlink
– You can add or duplicate the note template
2. FOR PRINTABLE PLANNER
– Download PDF file and print it on paper (US Letter size)
WHAT YOU WILL GET:
1 PDF file (8 pages that you can repeatedly print for weekly planner base or daily notes)
8 PNG files
